traps.text: The Outlook calendar shows the VPN training meeting at the wrong time, how do I change my time zone?

Not an account problem: my wireless keyboard stopped responding after I spilled coffee on it.

VPN works fine, but the printer is offline and my print jobs stay in the queue.
Not a network issue: the laptop fan is very loud and the laptop overheats and freezes.
SAP is fine but my mouse pointer freezes whenever it is connected to the docking station.
Since the mailbox restore last week I am not receiving emails from external customers.
DNS seems fine, the supplier website shows 'Blocked by corporate policy'.
Need SQL Server Management Studio installed on my laptop for a training course.
The backup drive is fine, but my laptop shows a blue screen and restarts on its own.
